definition.par: sum of component PARs; each component = the player's production minus the median starter's production of that component at his position, over the season through that game's week

components.rush_par: rushing; QB sacks and sack yards here
components.turn_par: INTs thrown and every fumble, lost or not
components.hit_par: solo and assisted tackles, TFL, sacks (QB hurries not counted)

definition.avg_par: the player's average PAR over his games this season through that week
definition.percentiles: 10/25/50/75/90th percentile PAR among a team's players in the game
definition.starters: by usage per team-game (no snap counts): QB 1 by attempts, RB 1 by carries, WR 3 and TE 1 by targets, DL 4, LB 3, DB 4 by tackles
definition.compared_as: players with no roster position (DEF) are scored and compared as LB, as the live production score does
definition.null_component: a component that does not apply to the side of the ball is null
